purpose: Elevate the prospectively confirmed matched-engagement veterancy effect into an exact uncapped combat-exchange law.
conditions: All non-experience formation state, detection, initiative, air support, terrain, observability, and actor protection terms are held fixed.
The same stochastic normal draws are used in the compared engagements.
Neither compared loss fraction hits combat.max_loss_fraction.
Personnel is positive so realized loss fraction equals the computed attrition fraction.
promotion_rule: Promote SL8 only after the algebraic grid and production-equivalence tests pass. Capped-loss cases are explicitly outside the simple elasticity law and must be handled by the min-cap piecewise equation.
claim_boundary: Exact law of Pineland's uncapped synthetic combat equation, not an empirical casualty elasticity.
